whatToWatch.text: Seattle rolls into Santa Clara at 6-4 with two straight wins, and Vegas barely blinked — SF is only a 2.5-point favorite at home. This one's a coin flip with division juice.

The defense is the real headliner: 17.5 points allowed per game and 2.7 sacks a night, against a Niners offense that's been giving up 21.8 and getting home just 1.8 times per game. If Seattle's pass rush shows up, the math tilts hard.

Health is the honest asterisk — four Seahawks are out, including Leonard Williams, Quenton Nelson and Charles Cross, with one more questionable. San Francisco's missing two in C.J. West and Nate Hobbs. Depth guys decide this one, and a 46.5 total says points may be at a premium.

newsBlurb.text: Seattle emerges from the bye with its defense riding a hot stretch and a win over the Raiders still fresh on the tape — now it heads to San Francisco to prove the layoff sharpened rather than stalled it. The quarterback conversation hasn't quieted, and neither have the health questions coaches spent the week sorting through. Answers come fast on the road against the Niners.

predictor.disclaimer: For entertainment/informational purposes only — not betting advice.
